response: Saved Views is available today for every customer on a paid plan. Instead of rebuilding filters and sort orders each time you open a project, you can now save your exact configuration and return to it in one click. Every user can create up to 50 saved views, covering different projects, clients, or workflows, so your most-used setups are always within reach. Views can also be shared with your team, making it easy to keep everyone aligned on the same filters, priorities, and status groupings without repeating setup work for each person. Whether you're tracking overdue tasks, monitoring a sprint, or checking in on a specific client's progress, Saved Views helps your team move faster and stay organized. This update is included in all paid plans at no extra cost, so there's nothing new to purchase or configure beyond turning it on. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
